diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig` already references `module.eks.cluster_name` inside its local-exec command, so Terraform infers the dependency on `:module.eks` implicitly; the explicit `depends_on = [module.eks]` is redundant.

`:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class` already depends on `:module.eks` through its `triggers` (`module.eks.cluster_primary_security_group_id`, `module.eks.cluster_security_group_id`) and the rendered manifest, so the explicit `depends_on` entry for `module.eks` is redundant.

`:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class` already references `:module.karpenter` via `module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn` in `triggers` and in the rendered ec2_node_class manifest, so the explicit `depends_on` entry for `module.karpenter` is redundant.

`:resource.helm_release.karpenter` already references `:module.karpenter` in its `values` (`module.karpenter.service_account`, `module.karpenter.queue_name`), so the explicit `depends_on` entry for `module.karpenter` is redundant (the `null_resource.update_kubeconfig` and `data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster` entries are still needed).

`:resource.null_resource.delete_daemonset` deletes the `aws-node` VPC-CNI daemonset, which is only safe once the replacement Calico CNI is actually installed by `:resource.null_resource.create_calico_installation`. The two resources share no ordering edge (both only fan in on the kubeconfig/cluster), so Terraform may delete `aws-node` first and leave nodes with no working CNI.
